The '''Western Reaches Superiority Force''' was a [[superiority fleet]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admirals]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] and [[Bannidge Holt]] during the [[Western Reaches Operation]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].
